title: Sometimes old school is better!
text: Sometimes old school is better!. I used to use can openers like this back in the day and eventually started using electric ones. Although they are convenient, they take up valuable counter space and I eventually went back to the old standard. I really like this one. The turn handle is larger, makes it super easy to turn and the cut is clean and quick. This is a great multi-function gadget, I think it would make a great bridal shower or housewarming gift add-on.

product_metadata.title: Forc Manual Smooth Edge Can Opener Handheld with Large Turn Knob 3-in-1 Multifunction Bottle Opener
features: 3-In-1 Manual Can Opener: Multifunctional can opener, you can use it to open cans, pry the can lids and unscrew the bottle caps,this can opener can be used in kinds of cans, which can meet the various needs of your daily life at the same time.
304 Stainless Steel Blade: The knife head adopts a 20-degree deflection angle design to achieve the best angle for opening the can, making the knife head and the can more fit, simple operation.

Innovative Design: Can opener (durable) has an ERGONOMIC handle that sits nicely in your hand without slipping or sliding, and has an easy to turn knob that won’t hurt your fingers. Tin can opener also makes just the PERFECT gift to all loved ones for all festive and non-festive occasions!

Smooth Edge Cut: Using our can opener, the edge of the can after cutting is smooth and round without scratching,leaving no burr and sharp gears. After opening the can, you can enjoy the delicious food safely.

Easy to Clean and Store: After you use can opener to open the can, the sharp cutting blade will not touch the food in the can, so it is easy to clean. After use, just use clean water wash under the tap. After washing it, you can hang it dry and store it to save space while keeping it clean and tidy.
